title: Basket — Pay Now reaches the Payment Process after a payment type is selected
custom_preface:
This test is to confirm pressing Pay Now from the Basket reaches the Payment Process once
a payment type is selected.
custom_preconds: **GIVEN** the Basket screen is displayed with at least one item and "Pay Now" available

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the customer presses Pay Now, then selects a payment type on the "Select Payment
Type" screen

custom_expected: Pressing Pay Now and selecting a payment type from the basket starts the Payment Process.

title: Basket — Pay Now (Basket - 2025 variant) continues the payment flow
custom_preface:
This test is to confirm pressing Pay Now from the Basket, where the "Select Payment Type
(Basket - 2025)" variant screen is shown, continues the payment flow as normal.
custom_preconds: **GIVEN** the Basket screen is displayed with at least one item and "Pay Now" available

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** the customer presses Pay Now and the "Select Payment Type (Basket - 2025)" screen
is shown
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the payment flow continues as normal

custom_expected: From the Basket - 2025 variant of Select Payment Type, the payment flow continues as normal.

title: Smartcards — a card write error can end in Faulty smartcard No Update
custom_preface:
This test is to confirm a card write error during the Payment Process, followed by the
Faulty smartcard - Try Again message, can end at the Faulty smartcard - No Update message.
custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** the TVM has shown the "Faulty smartcard - Try Again" message following a card
write error

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the customer retries and the write still fails
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the "Faulty smartcard - No Update" message is displayed
**AND** **GAP** — the source flow-map does not label what determines this outcome versus
the "No Update - Cash" outcome from the same screen; confirm before running

custom_expected: A card write error can end in the Faulty smartcard No Update message (trigger for this vs. the Cash variant unconfirmed).
